name: Yashiro Akira
source:
Akira is the vocalist of the Visual kei band Panic in Nagoya. He blames Shikanosuke for his cross-dressing.

[spoiler]In Curtain Call, Akira becomes the guitarist for HAPPY CYCLE MANIA.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kirakira_(visual_novel)]Wikipedia[/url]]
